description: Client-ready deliverable: the style-profile analysis rendered as a finished English PDF report (palette with color names, style-aware outfit formulas, virtual draping boards with disclosed candidate conflicts, honest confidence) returned as report_pdf_base64 + full profile JSON. For agents serving human end-clients. Flat $2.99/call, or $1.99/unit with a prepaid report_pack credit (pass pack_code).

image_url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the image (JPEG/PNG/WebP)

name.description: client name printed on the report (same field as REST; client_name is accepted as an alias)

style.description: One of: feminine, masculine, neutral. Styling context: feminine, masculine or neutral

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.

name: style_report

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

payment_required.description: true when status is 402: body holds x402 payment terms, not a result. Pay and call again with x_payment

receipt_id.description: set on paid results; free re-fetch via get_receipt

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)
